CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFTABLE

CFTABLE is the quick way to show a query. Describe each column with a CFCOL tag and CFTABLE does the looping. By default it produces a fixed-width text table inside <PRE>, which every browser since Mosaic can show; add HTMLTABLE for a real HTML table.

Category

Output and page processing

Syntax

<CFTABLE QUERY="query_name"
    MAXROWS="max_rows"
    COLSPACING="number_of_spaces"
    HEADERLINES="number_of_lines"
    HTMLTABLE
    BORDER
    COLHEADERS
    STARTROW="row">
  <CFCOL ...>
</CFTABLE>

Attributes

QUERY
Required. Name of the query to display.
MAXROWS
Optional. Maximum number of rows to show.
STARTROW
Optional, default "1". First row to show.
COLSPACING
Optional, default "2". Number of spaces between columns in the text format.
HEADERLINES
Optional, default "2". Lines used by the header in the text format: the header row plus blank lines.
HTMLTABLE
Optional. Produce an HTML <TABLE> instead of preformatted text.
BORDER
Optional. Draw a border around an HTML table.
COLHEADERS
Optional. Show the HEADER of each CFCOL as a heading row. Without it there is no header.

Usage

HTMLTABLE, BORDER and COLHEADERS are switches: just write the attribute name. In the text format each column is padded or cut to the WIDTH given in its CFCOL, and any HTML tags in the column text count towards that width, so keep markup out of text tables.

CFTABLE is convenient, but for anything fancier (colors, links, totals) use CFOUTPUT with QUERY and write the table yourself.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="Staff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="6">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Department, Salary
FROM Employees
ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>

<H4>HTML table</H4>
<CFTABLE QUERY="Staff" HTMLTABLE BORDER COLHEADERS>
  <CFCOL HEADER="Name" TEXT="#FirstName# #LastName#">
  <CFCOL HEADER="Department" TEXT="#Department#">
  <CFCOL HEADER="Salary" ALIGN="Right" TEXT="#DollarFormat(Salary)#">
</CFTABLE>

<H4>Preformatted text, rows 2 to 4</H4>
<CFTABLE QUERY="Staff" COLHEADERS STARTROW="2" MAXROWS="3" COLSPACING="3">
  <CFCOL HEADER="Last name" WIDTH="12" TEXT="#LastName#">
  <CFCOL HEADER="Department" WIDTH="12" TEXT="#Department#">
  <CFCOL HEADER="Salary" WIDTH="12" ALIGN="Right" TEXT="#DollarFormat(Salary)#">
</CFTABLE>
